answer: Tie voting weight to an exclusive, probeable berth. Each identity may reserve only one public endpoint per epoch, and attestations count only after established peers confirm that slot answers uniquely and is not shared. Two clones cannot occupy the same berth, and a vacated slot stays closed until the next checkpoint. Probes from a high mesa relay and a harbor jetty must both see the same exclusive handshake plus a rotating violet nonce that cannot be lent to a sibling. Shared or silent berths stay weightless, so minting extra keys cannot multiply influence.
